statement: Let X be the full perfected joint frame space over E. There is a Pn × U0-equivariant description of X as the space of exact sequences 0 −→ Om −→ Vn −→ Vt −→ 0 (5.1) whose determinant comparison is a Z× p -multiple of a fixed comparison. Forgetting the middle frame gives a Pn-torsor X → Z. Thus, for every compact open U ⊂ U0, [X/U /Pn] ≃ [Z/U]. (5.2) 28 On the quotient there is the universal sequence 0 −→ Lm ⊗ O −→ V ′ n −→ V ′ t −→ 0, where Lm has its integral etale lattice and the two positive bundles have compact frame reductions. Finally, Nt ≃ A1,⋄ C /F, (5.3) where F/Qp is unramified of degree t, acting by translations.
